name: REFramework
summary: Mod framework, scripting platform, and VR injector for RE Engine games (Resident Evil 2/3/4/Village/8, Devil May Cry 5, Monster Hunter Rise/Wilds, and others). Injects Dual-View Rendering and 6DOF headtracking into RE Engine titles via dinput8.dll. The RE Engine counterpart to UEVR.
compatibility_notes: RE Engine only. DX11 and DX12. Actively maintained by Praydog (same author as UEVR). Compatible with SteamVR and OpenXR runtimes.
